select psi.id as sourceId, psid.id as sourceDetailId, psi.purchase_order_id as purchaseOrderId, psi.purchase_order_code as purchaseOrderCode, psid.purchase_order_detail_id as purchaseOrderDetailId, psi.supplier_name as supplierName, psid.sku_id as skuId, psid.sku_no as skuNo, psi.delivery_warehouse_id as deliveryWarehouseId, psi.delivery_warehouse_name as deliveryWarehouseName, psid.stock_in_qty as stockInQty, psid.warehouse_location as warehouseLocation from po_instock psi inner join po_instock_detail psid on psi.id = psid.main_id and psid.is_deleted = false
psid.is_deleted = false
and psi.id in
#{item}
order by psi.purchase_order_code desc

SELECT psi.purchase_order_id, psid.sku_id, psid.sku_no, psi.approve_status, SUM(psid.stock_in_qty) AS stockInQty FROM po_instock psi INNER JOIN po_instock_detail psid ON psi.id = psid.main_id AND psi.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE psid.is_deleted = FALSE AND psi.invalid_status = FALSE
and psi.id in
#{item}
GROUP BY psi.purchase_order_id, psid.sku_id, psid.sku_no, psi.approve_status

select pi.supplier_id,count(distinct pi.id) as instock_count, sum(pid.stock_in_qty) as instock_qty from po_instock pi inner join po_instock_detail pid on pid.main_id = pi.id and pid.is_deleted = false where pi.approve_status = 'approve' and pi.is_deleted = false
and pi.supplier_id in
#{item}
AND pi.stock_in_date >= #{dateList[0]} AND (#{dateList[1]}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > pi.stock_in_date
group by pi.supplier_id

SELECT min(pi.stock_in_date) AS firstMassProductDate, pid.sku_id FROM po_instock pi INNER JOIN po_instock_detail pid ON pi.id = pid.main_id AND pi.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pid.is_deleted = FALSE AND pi.is_first_mass_product = TRUE
AND pi.id IN
#{id}
GROUP BY pid.sku_id

select COALESCE(sum(psid.stock_in_qty),0) as totalQty from po_instock psi inner join po_instock_detail psid on psi.id = psid.main_id and psid.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and psi.is_deleted = false
